title: At school
author: Shénbǐ
description: Pencils, erasers, a schoolbag, a writing brush and a blackboard for your world, plus classmates, homework, exams and 上课 / 下课, a day-at-school story, and 14 sentences to read.

words.hint: The 笔 of 神笔, your magic brush! 竹 (bamboo) on top: brushes have bamboo handles.
毛 hair + 笔 brush: the tip is made of animal hair.
铅 lead (钅 metal) + 笔 pen.
橡 rubber tree + 皮 skin.
书 book (you know it) + 包 bag.
本 is 木 tree with a mark at the root; paper comes from trees.
尺 is an old unit of length, about a third of a metre.
剪 to cut + 刀 knife.
黑 black (you know it) + 板 board (木 wood).
教 to teach + 室 room.
同 same + 学 study: someone who studies with you.
考 to examine + 试 to try.
作 to do + 业 work.
上 up/start + 课 lesson.
下 down/end + 课 lesson: the best sound of the day.
学 learn + 习 practise: what you're doing right now.
写 write + 字 character.
认 to recognize + 真 true: taking things truly seriously.
Chinese isn't 难, it's just new!
The opposite of 难.

books.title: 上学
books.blurb: A day at school with Xiaoming.

pages.en: Xiaoming is a student. He is eight years old.
In the morning he carries his schoolbag to school.
In the schoolbag there are books, notebooks, a pencil and an eraser.
Class begins. The teacher says: "Hello, class!"
Today there is a Chinese lesson. Xiaoming writes characters in his notebook.
He writes one character wrong and rubs it out with the eraser.
Class is over! Xiaoming and his classmates run all around outside.
Is Chinese hard? Xiaoming says: "Not hard! It's really interesting!"
